# United Apex Developers

> United Apex Developers is a remote AI business automation agency. We build AI receptionists and AI agents, high-converting websites, and custom mobile & web apps for businesses across the US, UK, Canada, and Europe.

## Services

- **AI Receptionist & AI Agents** — 24/7 AI receptionists and agents for sales, support, lead generation, appointment booking, and multilingual customer interaction. Deployed to website, phone, WhatsApp, or CRM. See /ai-agents.html
- **Website Design & Development** — Custom, conversion-focused websites, no templates. Includes SEO setup and hosting/domain configuration.
- **App Development** — Custom iOS, Android, and web apps built from scratch — booking platforms, marketplaces, client portals, and MVPs. See /app-development.html
- **Website + AI Bundle** and **Full-Stack Bundle** — Website, app, and AI receptionist delivered together as a single package.
- **Website Maintenance & App Maintenance** — Ongoing updates, bug fixes, and monitoring.
- **SEO & Google Ranking** — Technical SEO, keyword research, and local SEO.

## Company

- Fully remote, international team — no physical office.
- Serves clients across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and Europe.
- Contact: unitedapexdevelopers@gmail.com
- Response time: within 24 hours.
- Pricing: custom quotes based on project scope — no fixed public pricing.
